title: When the Interior Falls
author: Wendell Fairweather
blurb: Silas Delacroix, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
